title: Wirex launches X-Accounts
description: Wirex announced the launch of X-Accounts as an app-based product for earning interest through crypto and DeFi-linked allocations.
notes: Product launch event for X-Accounts, not the launch of the broader Wirex platform.

title: Wirex expands the asset set supporting X-Accounts
description: Wirex announced additional crypto-assets on its platform and described continued expansion of X-Accounts shortly after the product launch.
notes: Early product-expansion milestone; historical availability does not establish the current asset list.

title: Wirex documents current Flexible, Plus, and Fixed X-Accounts
description: Current Wirex materials described active Flexible, Plus, and Fixed X-Account variants with variable or fixed rates, weekly interest, different lockups, and different withdrawal conditions.
notes: Current-state snapshot; country eligibility, assets, limits, rates, and exact terms can change.

title: SwissBorg launches USDC Smart Yield
description: SwissBorg released its first USDC Smart Yield wallet to an initial user cohort and began rolling the product out through the app.
notes: Launch date is directly stated in the first-party announcement.

title: SwissBorg reports broad Smart Yield expansion
description: SwissBorg reported that Smart Yield had expanded from the original USDC wallet to nineteen additional tokens and had been used through hundreds of thousands of wallets.
notes: Historical scale and product-expansion event; figures are first-party operating metrics.

title: SwissBorg introduces Earn as the next stage of Smart Yield
description: SwissBorg launched SwissBorg Earn, replacing the one-size-fits-all Smart Yield approach with multiple asset- and risk-specific yield strategies.
notes: Product evolution rather than closure or rebrand of the whole SwissBorg platform.

title: SwissBorg Earn remains active with strategy-specific risk and fee terms
description: Current SwissBorg materials described active Earn strategies, subscriptions, redemptions, APY presentation, risk scores, earnings history, and strategy-specific performance and service fees.
notes: Current-state snapshot. Strategy availability, protocol exposure, payout timing, caps, cooldowns, APY, and fees can change.
